AMGN.headline: Oppenheimer Maintains Outperform on Amgen, Raises Price Target to $480

AMGN.summary: Oppenheimer has raised its price target for Amgen Inc. to $480 from $450 while maintaining an Outperform rating.

AMGN.headline: Amgen to Host Investor Webcast During ESMO 2026 Congress

AMGN.headline: AstraZeneca/Amgen Drug Shows Significant Remission in Eosinophilic Esophagitis Study
AMGN.summary: AstraZeneca and Amgen report positive Phase 3 Tezspire data, showing sustained remission in eosinophilic esophagitis patients over 52 weeks.
